spans.s:
2 यम॑ (f. आ॑ & ई॑) paired, twin;
 m. a twin (du. twins),
N. of a god, either the Twin (with his sister यमी॑ f.) or the
Restrainer, the god of death. n. pair, twin letter (g.)
2 याम॑ f. ई॑ belonging to or coming from Yama.

यमक a. double, twofold;
 n. a kind of paronomasia ((rh.)).
यमगाथा॑ f. a verse or hymn relating to Yama.

यमज a. twin-born;
 m. du. twins.

यम˚जात a. twin-born;
 m. du. twins.

यम˚जातक a. twin-born;
 m. du. twins.
यम॑नेत्र a. having Yama as a guide.

यमल a. twin, paired, doubled;
 m. a twin.

यमवन्त् a. having self-possession, who governs or
controls himself.
यम॑श्रेष्ठ a. pl. having Yama as chief.
यमसदन n. Yama's seat or abode.

यामिनी f. night;
 a woman's name.
यमु॑ना f. N. of river (identif. w. यमी॑).
यमे॑ष्ट n. a sacrifice offered to Yama.
यामहू॑ a. to be called or being ready to help.

यामिक a. keeping watch;
 m. watchman, night-watcher.
